$comment: Declared operations — the app's verbs, discoverable and callable by the CraftBot agent via the livingui CLI (livingui <project> --help / run <op>). Declare an op for every side-effectful capability (anything beyond plain CRUD). Executor types: http (backend endpoint), sql (parameterized statement), shell (declared command run in the project dir; use mode 'job' for long-running work). See the living-ui-creator skill's OPERATIONS.md reference for the full spec.

reset.description: Reset the application state to empty
